title: Accounts and Business Advisory Associate

description:

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join a highly respected Top 10 accountancy practice in Norwich. Working with a diverse portfolio of owner-managed businesses, SMEs and growing organisations, you'll become part of a collaborative and supportive team that invests heavily in the development of its people.
Your new role

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Are you looking for your next step up within practice, with the opportunity to develop your skills, progress your career, continue studying and work alongside a brilliant team?

NXTGEN are working with a fantastic accountancy practice on the outskirts of Wymondham who are looking for an Accounts Assistant to join their supportive team. Having worked closely with this client for several years, I know they offer a great environment for someone who wants to build on their existing experience, take on more responsibility and progress their career.

You'll be joining a friendly and supportive team, working with a varied portfolio of local SME clients and gaining exposure to a range of year-end accounts, management accounts, tax and VAT work. You'll have the opportunity to build strong relationships with your clients, become their main point of contact and support them with their day-to-day accounting needs, all while continuing to develop your technical knowledge and experience alongside your studies.

Key Responsibilities:
- Preparing year-end accounts for a varied portfolio of local SME clients.
- Assisting with tax returns, VAT returns and other accounting requirements.
- Preparing management accounts.
- Building relationships with clients and acting as a key point of contact for any queries.
- Supporting clients with their day-to-day accounting needs.
- Working closely with the wider team to continue building on your existing knowledge and experience.
- Working across a range of accounting software, including QuickBooks, Sage and Xero.

What's in it for you?
- A genuinely supportive firm that will invest in your studies, personal development and career progression.
- A clear progression pathway, tailored to your own career goals and aspirations.
- Study support and guidance to help you balance your qualifications alongside your day-to-day workload.
- Exposure to a varied portfolio of local SME clients, giving you the opportunity to broaden your experience across accounts, tax and VAT.
- The opportunity to attend networking events and business breakfasts if you'd like to develop your professional network.
- The chance to make a genuine impact within a smaller firm, where you can build strong relationships with both your clients and colleagues.
- A relaxed and friendly working environment where you'll be supported to develop and progress.
- Flexibility and hybrid working.

This is a great opportunity for someone who already has some experience within practice and is looking for their next step, whether that's broadening their accounts experience, gaining more exposure to management accounts and client work, or continuing to work towards their professional qualifications with a firm that will support them along the way.

There's lots more to the role, so if you're looking for an opportunity where you can develop your skills, continue studying and progress your career as part of a brilliant team, I'd love to hear from you!

Get in touch with Annie at NXTGEN Recruitment to find out more

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
This position has now been filled. If you are interested in this type of vacancy moving forward, please do send your CV across for the future

This is a great opportunity to join a well-established, family-run business that is continuing to grow. The role is hands-on, tasked with supporting the day-to-day financial operations of the business and working alongside the existing accounts function.

As a key team member, you'll be responsible for keeping the financial side of the business running smoothly - using your proven accounts experience to provide integral support within the finance and administration operations, showcasing your practical and proactive approach to work.

This opportunity is based a few miles outside of Great Yarmouth and due to the remote location, a driving license and vehicle is essential.

Salary is offered at £30,000 with the role being considered both full-time or part-time at a minimum of 30 hours per week.

Benefits
- Flexible working considered
- Opportunity to work from home once established in the role
- 3 days' annual leave used for the Christmas/New Year shutdown
- Holiday entitlement increases after 2 years, from 20 up to 25 days
- Stakeholder pension scheme
- Free parking
- Bi-annual company socials
- Corporate workwear if required
- A friendly, family-run working environment with a genuinely non-hierarchical culture

The Company

Working across sectors including healthcare, education and national infrastructure, this business provides a specialist service to clients across the UK and parts of Europe.

The company has a close-knit, down-to-earth culture, with strong team morale and a genuine willingness to all muck in and get things done. As the business continues to scale, this is an excellent opportunity to become apart of the growth and join a business where everyone really does play their part.

The Day to Day
- Recording and maintaining accurate financial transactions and records
- Processing supplier invoices and making payments
- Raising customer invoices and uploading invoices to relevant portals
- Reconciling supplier statements and bank accounts
- Monitoring aged debtors and highlighting outstanding payments
- Maintaining and reviewing sales and purchase ledgers
- Supporting payroll preparation, including expenses and relevant payroll data
- Assisting with VAT returns and other financial reporting
- Supporting the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial information
- Providing financial information for management review
- Identifying and highlighting discrepancies and helping to resolve them
- Supporting internal and external audits and maintaining compliance with financial procedures

You Will Have / Be
- Previous experience in a similar accounts-based role with understanding of accounting principles
- Experience using accounting software such as Sage or Xero
- Good understanding of sales and purchase ledgers
- Experience with reconciliations and balancing accounts
- Awareness of aged debtors and the importance of timely payment
- A baseline understanding of P&L
- Good attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise your workload
- Happy to speak to customers and suppliers regarding accounts queries when required
- A proactive, self-motivated and flexible approach

An accountancy qualification would be useful but isn't essential. What matters most is that you understand the fundamentals of accounts and have the practical experience to get on with the job.

How to Apply

To hear more details about this opportunity, please email your CV to Ruth Harding - Business Partner at R13 Recruitment. If you do not hear from us within 5 working days of submitting your CV, please assume you have been unsuccessful on this occasion

title: Accounts Payroll Clerk
description:
We are currently recruiting for an Accounts Payroll Clerk to join our client, a leading oil and gas operator, as part of their busy Finance team in Norwich.
This is a great opportunity for someone with previous Accounts Payable experience who is confident working in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with both internal teams and external suppliers.
You will primarily support the Accounts Payable function, ensuring invoices are processed accurately and efficiently while working closely with colleagues across Finance, Procurement and other internal departments.
Key Responsibilities
- Process supplier invoices and credit notes in line with agreed terms and internal procedures.
- Manage a high volume of invoices through an electronic approval workflow.
- Process goods-received invoices by matching them against purchase orders, as well as more complex service invoices.
- Ensure all relevant supporting documentation is complete and attached for approval and audit purposes.
- Code service invoices to the correct cost centres, working with Cost Controllers and Budget Holders where required.
- Take ownership of high-value and large contract invoices, maintaining strong relationships with key suppliers.
- Respond to supplier queries by phone and email, resolving issues promptly or escalating where appropriate.
- Liaise with Procurement and other internal teams to resolve invoice and supplier queries.
- Complete supplier statement reconciliations, investigate discrepancies and ensure outstanding items are resolved.
- Support the shared Accounts mailbox, ensuring queries and invoices are dealt with promptly and accurately.
- Work closely with internal departments to ensure Accounts Payable processes are followed correctly.
- Identify opportunities to improve and streamline Accounts Payable processes.
- Provide support and cover for other team members during busy periods and periods of absence.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience within Accounts Payable or a similar finance role.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Experience using SAP or a similar finance/accounting system would be advantageous, although training can be provided.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy.
- Good understanding of cost centres and financial coding.
- Ability to work independently, use your own initiative and work effectively as part of a team.
- Comfortable working in a busy environment and managing competing priorities.
- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.
- Flexible, adaptable and open to change.

The Opportunity This is a great opportunity to join an established Finance team within a leading oil and gas operator, where you will work across a varied range of invoices, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
If you are an experienced Accounts Assistant or Accounts Payable professional looking for your next opportunity in Norwich, we'd be keen to hear from you.
With over 90 years' combined experience, NES Fircroft (NES) is proud to be the world's leading engineering staffing provider spanning the Oil & Gas, Power & Renewables, Chemicals, Construction & Infrastructure, Life Sciences, Mining and Manufacturing sectors worldwide. With more than 80 offices in 45 countries, we are able to provide our clients with the engineering and technical expertise they need, wherever and whenever it is needed. We offer contractors far more than a traditional recruitment service, supporting with everything from securing visas and work permits, to providing market-leading benefits packages and accommodation, ensuring they are safely and compliantly able to support our clients.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
NXTGEN are delighted to be working exclusively with a well-established, family-run business based south of Norwich, who are looking to recruit a Finance Assistant on a permanent basis.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a close-knit finance team within a successful, growing business with a strong reputation for quality and service. The company prides itself on delivering exceptional products to customers across the UK and internationally, offering a welcoming working environment where attention to detail, teamwork and a hands-on approach are valued.

Working within a busy finance function, you will support the day-to-day running of the accounts department, taking responsibility for a varied range of transactional finance duties and supporting the wider team with accurate financial reporting.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing both the purchase ledger and sales ledger.
- Processing sales invoices and ensuring transactions are recorded accurately.
- Completing bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Preparing and reconciling debtor and creditor statements.
- Assisting with the preparation and submission of VAT returns.
- Processing payments in multiple currencies.
- Supporting month-end processes and preparing relevant financial reports.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring all transactions are processed in a timely manner.
- Providing general support to the finance team as required.

About You:

We are looking for someone with previous experience in a similar finance or accounts administration role, with a good understanding of purchase ledger and sales ledger processes. You will have strong numerical skills, excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to your work, ensuring accuracy across all aspects of the role.

Experience using Sage Line 50 would be highly beneficial, alongside good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook. You will also be organised, proactive and confident communicating with colleagues at all levels. The ability to use your own initiative, manage competing priorities and bring a positive, can-do attitude to a busy team will be key to your success.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Randstad Sourceright, a leading provider of RPO & MSP Recruitment Services, is currently recruiting for a Finance Assistant on behalf of Siemens UK. This role is essential for supporting the Deep Tube Upgrade Programme (DTUP) for the London Piccadilly line, working closely with the Commercial Manager across key project workstreams including Commissioning, Stabling, CMA, Retrofit, and Engineering.

Job Purpose

To provide day-to-day project accounting, financial controlling, and reporting support across multiple project activities. You will collaborate with Commercial Managers, Project Managers, Operations, and Finance teams to ensure accurate financial forecasting, maintain cost control, and deliver insightful analysis to drive financial performance.

Responsibilities
- Month-End & Financial Reporting: Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end processes in compliance with Siemens guidelines; maintain accounting principles, accruals, and cost centre controls.
- Forecasting & Budgeting: Assist in preparing monthly project forecasts, cost centre forecasting, headcount tracking, and annual budgets.
- Project Accounting & Cost Control: Update and maintain Percentage of Completion (PoC) models, monitor project costs, track Non-Conformance Costs (NCC), and investigate variances.
- Risk & Governance: Maintain Risk & Opportunity Registers and support Internal Controls on Financial Reporting (ICFR) as well as audit requirements.
- Transactions & Variations: Capture costs for Additional Services, Claims, and Variation Orders; manage GRIR balances, customer invoicing, debt collection, and supplier invoice queries.
- Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to optimize financial reporting through digital tools, automation, and Copilot.

About You
- Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience in project accounting, financial reporting, cost controlling, or management accounting.
- Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in SAP accounting systems (e.g., Spiridon) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills are essential.
- Financial Knowledge: Proven understanding of core accounting principles, accruals, cost centres, month-end routines, and cost forecasting.
- Soft Skills: Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
- Digital Mindset: Practical mindset for process automation and familiarity with digital tools like Microsoft Copilot.

title: Payroll & HR Coordinator
description:
Are you a detail-driven Payroll professional looking to grow your HR experience? Join our dynamic retail team as a Payroll & HR Coordinator where you'll not only ensure people are paid accurately and on time but also play a key role in supporting the wider HR function.

About the Role

As a payroll coordinator, you'll take ownership of processing for stores and head office teams. You'll also get hands-on exposure to a variety of HR duties - from onboarding and employee record management to supporting day-to-day HR queries. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who wants to develop a broader career in HR within a fast-paced retail environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Process payroll accurately and on schedule for all employees.
- Manage payroll changes including new starters, leavers, and contract amendments.
- Ensure compliance with HMRC legislation, pensions, and statutory payments.
- Reconcile payroll reports and liaise with Finance for payment approvals.
- Maintain employee records in the HRIS and ensure data accuracy.
- Support HR with recruitment administration, onboarding, and absence tracking.
- Assist with HR projects and employee engagement initiatives.

What You'll Bring
- Previous experience in payroll administration
- Pensions experience (desirable)
- A good understanding of payroll legislation and best practice.
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Proficiency in MS Excel
- A proactive approach and willingness to get involved in broader HR activities.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunities for training and career development in both Payroll and HR.
- A friendly, supportive team culture within a growing retail brand.

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Payroll Assistant

Location: Diss

Salary: £27,300 per annum

Hours: Full-time, 37.5 hours per week

Contract: Permanent

Working Pattern: Office-based

About the Role

My client is looking to recruit an experienced Payroll Assistant to join their established and supportive finance team in Diss.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a solid background in payroll and pensions who enjoys working in a busy environment and takes pride in delivering an accurate, reliable and professional service.

You will be responsible for supporting the day-to-day payroll function, working with both clients and employees to resolve queries and ensuring payroll information is processed accurately and within strict deadlines.

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing payroll and pension information accurately and efficiently.
- Administering workplace pension schemes, including calculating and processing contributions.
- Liaising with pension providers and other relevant third parties when required.
- Responding to payroll queries from clients and employees, providing clear and helpful support.
- Handling payroll-related correspondence with HMRC and other external authorities.
- Dealing with matters including tax codes, PAYE, National Insurance and statutory payments.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date payroll records.
- Ensuring payroll information is handled confidentially and in line with GDPR requirements.
- Working to tight payroll deadlines and ensuring all work is completed accurately.
- Supporting the wider finance team with payroll-related administration where required.

About You

We are looking for someone who has:
- At least two years' experience working in payroll and pensions.
- Previous experience within an accountancy practice, payroll bureau or similar environment would be advantageous.
- Good knowledge of PAYE, National Insurance, pensions and current payroll legislation.
- Experience using payroll software; knowledge of systems such as BrightPay, Sage, Xero or QuickBooks would be beneficial.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise a busy workload.
- The confidence to communicate professionally with clients, employees and external organisations.
- The ability to work independently and meet strict deadlines.
- A proactive, reliable and professional approach.

What's on Offer?
- £27,300 salary
- 37.5-hour working week
- Permanent position
- Company pension
- Free on-site parking
- Health & wellbeing programme
- Company events
- Supportive working environment
- Opportunities for professional development and progression

If you're an experienced Payroll Assistant looking for your next opportunity in the Diss area, we'd love to hear from you.

Contact Rebecca at Keeler Recruitment -

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
NXTGEN Recruitment are pleased to be supporting a long-standing, highly reputable business based in Great Yarmouth in their search for a Purchase Ledger Clerk.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established business with a genuinely family-feel culture, where people are valued, teamwork comes naturally, and there is a real sense of working together. The business has built a brilliant internal culture, making it an ideal environment for someone looking to join a supportive team where they can feel settled and make a positive contribution.

- Managing supplier queries and maintaining strong working relationships.

- Maintaining accurate purchase ledger records and keeping accounts up to date.
- Working closely with the wider finance team to ensure the smooth running of day-to-day finance operations.

This is more than just another purchase ledger position. It's an opportunity to join a reputable, established business that genuinely values its people and has created a fantastic in-house culture. If you're looking for a role where you can become part of a close-knit team, build relationships and play an important part in the day-to-day running of the finance function, this could be a great fit. title: Sales Ledger Clerk
description:
Sales Ledger / Accounts Receivable Assistant

Working closely with the Financial Controller, you'll take ownership of day-to-day sales ledger activity, ensuring accounts are accurate, payments are received on time and outstanding balances are managed effectively.

You'll be joining a successful business with a strong reputation for delivering technically complex projects, working with customers across a range of specialist markets. The business continues to develop and invest in its operations, providing an interesting environment in which to build your finance experience.

The Role
- Raising sales invoices and credit notes, and maintaining the daily sales register
- Allocating customer payments and reconciling the sales ledger to the general ledger
- Monitoring outstanding balances and following up overdue payments
- Dealing with customer account queries and resolving discrepancies
- Preparing aged debt reports and reviewing overdue accounts
- Leading weekly accounts receivable meetings to review outstanding balances
- Maintaining accurate records and supporting improvements to finance processes

About You

You'll have previous experience in a Sales Ledger, Accounts Receivable or Credit Control role and be confident managing customer accounts and resolving payment queries.

You'll be organised, accurate and comfortable communicating with colleagues and customers at different levels. Experience using SAP would be useful, but isn't essential.

Please apply online or contact Justin Murray at Big Sky Additions for further information.

title: Sales Ledger Clerk
description:
NXTGEN Recruitment are pleased to be working with a well-established and successful business based in Larling, Norfolk, who are looking to recruit an experienced Sales & Purchase Ledger Assistant to support their busy finance team on a temporary basis.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a strong background in transactional finance who enjoys a varied, hands-on role and is confident managing both sales and purchase ledger processes. You'll be joining a friendly, hardworking team within a family-run business, where accuracy, organisation and a proactive approach are highly valued.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently, managing their workload and ensuring day-to-day finance processes run smoothly.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices, ensuring accuracy and correct allocation.
- Managing sales ledger transactions, including raising and processing sales invoices.
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving invoice or payment discrepancies.
- Monitoring outstanding customer balances and assisting with debtor management.
- Completing bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Preparing supplier payments, including multi-currency transactions.
- Supporting with VAT returns and month-end reporting.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and assisting the wider finance team with ad hoc tasks.

What we're looking for:
- Previous experience in a sales ledger, purchase ledger or accounts assistant position.
- Confident using Sage 50, with previous hands-on experience highly desirable.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when processing financial transactions.
- Good Excel skills and confidence working with accounting systems.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and manage deadlines.
- A positive, flexible approach and willingness to get involved wherever needed.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced transactional finance professional looking for their next temporary assignment. The role would suit someone who can quickly get up to speed, take ownership of the ledgers and provide valuable support to an established finance function.

If you're available for temporary work and have experience across sales and purchase ledger, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or contact NXTGEN Recruitment for further information.
